services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: The Escape is a SeaArk 54. She is 54' long x 14' wide, has 11 tables onboard, is covered to provide shelter from the elements, is equipped with a head (restroom), and is most commonly used for our private charters. All prices are starting rates. Gratuity not included. A customary tip is at least 20%. We welcomed the Second Nature to our fleet in the late season of 2021. She was custom built by Sarasota Bay Boat Company, is 17' x 64' long, has an upper and lower deck, and is equipped with 2 marine heads (restrooms). blurb: Cape Water Tours offers narrated, educational ecology and birding tours, sunset cruises, dolphin watching, and live music cruises. They operate primarily from May through October with some off-season tours. Their boats accommodate groups up to 100 guests and allow bringing your own food and drinks.

quotes.text: The sunset cruise was a blast and the captains were very informative and fun. I loved that we could bring our own drinks and snacks. Would recommend to anyone looking for a fun relaxing evening.
Enjoyed the eco-tour with three teens Each of us learned a few things and enjoyed seeing the landscape from the canal perspective. Definitely recommend as a family activity.
Great tour of the canal. We loved the eco-tour. The staff, both Captain Steve and tour leader Kathleen, were well informed, friendly, and very helpful. We'll do it again!
Our guide was so nice and explained things to us and stayed extra time to view the dolphins. It was a beautiful trip and I'd recommend it to anyone!
